summary: The plan now scopes inventory work exactly to records associated with code changes and contains no inventory-system improvement phase.
findings: Execution phases start at Phase 1 with code changes; inventory tooling, schemas, reports, validators, gates, and unrelated records are explicitly out of scope. The requested phase-8 closure file deletion is included.
residual_risks: Existing unrelated inventory inaccuracies remain intentionally untouched until their corresponding source modules are changed.
